articles.titleZh: TZME 成功向美国硼砂公司供应高性能笼式磨机备件，严格动平衡检测保障可靠性
articles.summaryZh: 天津，2026年7月10日——TZME 宣布，已向全球领先的硼酸盐生产商美国硼砂公司（U.S. Borax）成功交付两套高性能笼式磨机备件，用于其核心破碎工序。双方通过此次合作建立了牢固的合作关系。
articles.contentZh:
美国硼砂公司（U.S. Borax）是力拓集团旗下企业，在加利福尼亚州博朗运营一座世界级矿山，供应全球约 30% 的精制硼酸盐产品。作为美国历史最悠久的矿业公司之一，该公司拥有约 1,000 名员工，为全球 500 家客户提供服务。

作为合格的备件供应商，TZME 提供的这些笼式磨机部件用于美国硼砂公司矿石破碎生产线的日常运行与维护。从选材到机械加工，各环节均经过严格控制。值得一提的是，每套产品在发运前均按照国际标准进行了 100% 动平衡检测，确保高速旋转状态下的稳定性和可靠性，有效降低振动与磨损，并显著延长设备使用寿命。

TZME 市场开发经理 Hannah 表示：“能够为美国硼砂公司这样的世界级矿业企业供应关键破碎设备备件，是对我们产品质量和技术能力的有力认可。动平衡检测是我们对每一件高速旋转备件的基本质量承诺。我们将以此为契机，进一步拓展北美矿业市场，为更多矿业客户提供高可靠性、精密制造的备件和技术服务。”

此次合作标志着 TZME 在北美矿业供应链，尤其是破碎设备备件这一细分领域取得了又一重要突破。公司将继续秉持“成为全球非标机械设备制造领域的领导者”的愿景，为全球矿业客户提供可靠的整机及备件解决方案。

关于 TZME（天津）有限公司

TZME 专注于为国际市场提供定制化、非标机械设备。产品组合丰富，包括港口机械、采矿机械、桥梁建设设备、旅游观光设施、装卸与输送系统、起重设备、冶金设备、压力容器、环保设备以及特种船舶。年综合生产能力超过 45,000 吨，产品受到众多国际知名客户的信赖，并出口至美国、德国、澳大利亚、巴西、日本、南非、加拿大、丹麦和韩国等 60 多个国家和地区。

我们在矿山机械制造方面拥有丰富经验，设备及备件已服务于多座大型矿山。参与的北美矿业项目包括 New Afton（铜矿）、Red Chris（铜金矿）、James Bay、IOC（铁矿）、Retrofit Mine（锌矿）、MFQ（金铜矿）以及 Marathon Gold（Valentine 金矿）。

如需了解更多信息，欢迎联系我们！
articles.titleEn: TZME Successfully Supplies High‑Performance Cage Mill Spare Parts to U.S. Borax with Rigorous Dynamic Balancing Testing Ensuring Reliability
articles.summaryEn: Tianjin, July 10, 2026 – TZME announced that it has successfully delivered two sets of high‑performance cage mill spare parts to U.S. Borax, a globally leading borate producer, for use in its core crushing process. The two parties have established a strong working relationship through this collaboration.
articles.contentEn:
U.S. Borax, a subsidiary of Rio Tinto, operates a world‑class mine in Boron, California, supplying approximately 30% of the world’s refined borate products. As one of the oldest mining companies in the United States, it employs around 1,000 people and serves 500 customers worldwide.

As a qualified spare parts supplier, TZME provided these cage mill components for the routine operation and maintenance of U.S. Borax’s ore crushing line. The products underwent stringent control from material selection to machining processes. Notably, each unit was 100% subjected to dynamic balancing testing in accordance with international standards before shipment, ensuring stability and reliability at high rotational speeds, effectively reducing vibration and wear, and significantly extending equipment service life.

Hannah, Market Development Manager at TZME, commented: “Being able to supply critical crushing equipment spare parts to a world‑class mining company like U.S. Borax is a strong validation of our product quality and technical expertise. Dynamic balancing testing is our fundamental quality commitment for every high‑speed rotating spare part. We see this as a stepping stone to further penetrate the North American mining market and provide more mining customers with highly reliable, precision‑engineered spare parts and technical services.

This partnership marks another major breakthrough for TZME in the North American mining supply chain, particularly in the niche segment of crushing equipment spare parts. The company will continue to uphold its vision – “To be the leader of global non‑standard mechanical manufacturers” – and deliver reliable complete machines and spare part solutions to mining customers worldwide.

About TZME（Tianjin) Co., Ltd.
TZME specializes in custom‑built, non‑standard machinery and equipment for the international market. Our diverse portfolio includes: port machinery, mining machinery, bridge construction equipment, tourist sightseeing facilities, handling & conveying systems, lifting equipment, metallurgical equipment, pressure vessels, environmental protection equipment, and special boats. With an annual comprehensive production capacity exceeding 45,000 tons, our products are trusted by a roster of internationally renowned clients and exported to more than 60 countries and regions, including the USA, Germany, Australia, Brazil, Japan, South Africa, Canada, Denmark, and South Korea.

We have extensive experience in mining machinery manufacturing, and our equipment and spare parts have served multiple major mines. Our involvement in North American mining projects includes: New Afton (Copper Mine), Red Chris (Copper‑Gold Mine), James Bay, IOC (Iron Ore), Retrofit Mine (Zinc Mine), MFQ (Gold‑Copper Mine), and Marathon Gold (Valentine Gold Mine).

For more information, please contact us!

articles.titleZh: TZME 成功亮相东京展会，达成多项高质量商务洽谈

articles.contentZh:
N-EXPO（东京国际环保展）是亚洲规模最大的环保展会，设有 1,300 多个展位，汇聚 700 多家国际参展商。

此次参展不仅展示了 TZME 在港口机械、运输设备、矿山机械、游乐设备等领域的成熟项目，以及最新款移动式模块化预制房屋，也拉近了公司与海外客户的距离。作为首次参加国际贸易展会的企业，我们的展位吸引了众多国际设备供应商的关注。MMI 模块化房屋模型在现场引发热烈兴趣，多家公司表达了对 TZME 制造能力和项目经验的关注。

作为服务国际客户的专业定制设备制造商，TZME 已与 60 多个国家的 100 多家重点客户建立合作，生产 70 多个产品品类。公司正积极拓展新的业务领域和市场机遇。TZME 将继续以专业与真诚服务全球客户，推动更多实质性合作落地。
articles.titleEn: TZME Successfully Debuted at Tokyo Exhibition, Secured Multiple High-Quality Business Talks
articles.summaryEn: TOKYO, Japan – Recently, TZME participated in the N-EXPO (Tokyo International Exhibition on Environmental Protection) held in Tokyo. During the exhibition, the TZME team engaged in in-depth discussions with several Japanese and international clients, focusing on technical collaboration and market expansion.
articles.contentEn:
The N-EXPO (Tokyo International Exhibition on Environmental Protection) is the largest environmental exhibition in Asia, featuring over 1,300 booths and more than 700 international exhibitors. 

This participation not only showcased TZME's mature projects in port machinery, transportation equipment, mining machinery, amusement equipments, as well as the latest models of mobile modular prefabricated houses, but also brought the company closer to overseas clients. As a first-time exhibitor at an international trade fair, our booth attracted considerable attention from international equipment suppliers. The MMI modular house models generated lively interest on site, with multiple companies expressing interest in TZME's manufacturing capabilities and project experience.

As a professional custom equipment manufacturer serving international clients, TZME has established cooperation with over 100 key clients in more than 60 countries, producing more than 70 product categories. The company is actively expanding into new fields and market opportunities. TZME will continue to serve global clients with professionalism and sincerity, and promote the implementation of more substantive cooperation.

articles.titleZh: 跨越洲际，连接能源未来：TZME 助力中加合作迈入新时代
articles.summaryZh: 随着中加两国重申能源合作承诺，TZME 正通过标志性项目建设关键基础设施。作为加拿大 REEF 海上管道项目的核心承包商，公司制造重达 600 吨的大型预制模块，连接北美与亚洲市场。一体化装船机也助力加拿大西海岸港口扩建，展现了全系统制造实力。通过先进模块化技术与严格国际标准，TZME 以实际行动诠释高端“中国制造”，这些项目也成为两国能源合作不断深化的具体体现。
articles.contentZh:
万吨级钢结构，跨越太平洋。

在这里，机械的轰鸣与焊接的火花交织成一曲工业交响，TZME 正锻造连接北美与亚洲的能源新通道。

“我们致力于扩大双边贸易、促进双向投资，并深化能源领域合作。”2026 年 1 月，加拿大总理 Mark J. Carney 访华期间，中加两国在联合声明中明确重申了加强能源合作的共同承诺。

这为两国企业在传统能源与清洁能源领域的合作打开了新局面。

在 TZME 格林兰制造基地，一批整装待发的大型管廊模块，正是这一合作愿景的生动体现。

01 政策新局

中加关系正进入新的发展阶段。加拿大总理访华期间，两国明确了能源、贸易等领域的合作重点。

《中加联合声明》强调清洁能源合作，并加强石油、天然气等传统资源开发领域的合作。

这一高层共识，为两国深化务实合作提供了政治保障与政策指引。

在良好政策环境的推动下，作为能源生产大国的加拿大，正积极扩建能源基础设施。其中，不列颠哥伦比亚省鲁珀特王子港被赋予重要战略定位，成为北美能源出口亚洲市场的关键枢纽，市场机遇日益显现。

02 项目成果

TZME（天津）有限公司已在加拿大市场建立起扎实基础。公司正在推进的两项重点项目，与中加能源合作的新方向高度契合。

REEF 海上管道项目是加拿大西海岸重要的液化石油气（LPG）出口枢纽，由加拿大能源企业 AltaGas 与荷兰皇家壳牌共同开发。

作为核心承包商，TZME 承担了全部 13 个大型管廊模块的制造。

项目采用模块化预制技术，单个模块长约 96 米、重近 600 吨，工厂预制率高达 90%，显著提高了工程效率与质量可控性。项目计划于 2026 年底完成，将成为连接北美与亚洲市场的重要能源通道。

为西海岸码头 Westshore 项目交付两台大型装船机，是 TZME 在加拿大取得的又一重要成果。项目中，公司承担了全部钢结构制造及机电系统的完整集成，为港口扩建交付关键装备。

通过严格遵循客户多层级技术标准，TZME 展示了在复杂国际项目中的协同执行和高质量交付能力。这一成果直接助力加拿大西海岸港口基础设施升级，支持该国扩大能源出口能力的战略。

03 制造无界

TZME 是中加能源合作领域“新质生产力”的代表。通过先进制造实践，公司展现了中国高端装备制造业的创新实力与全球竞争力。

TZME 采用先进的模块化预制与工厂集成生产模式，将复杂的现场施工转化为受控的工厂作业。这一方法在 REEF 项目中发挥了关键作用，大幅缩短现场施工时间，并显著提升工程质量。

与此同时，通过发展机、电、液一体化能力，TZME 实现了重型装备在工厂内的高效集成与协同调试。这种从单机制造向综合系统集成的转变，体现了新一代生产力在装备制造领域的应用。

公司坚持全过程质量控制，与国际标准接轨，确保产品符合加拿大严格的行业法规与安全标准。这份对质量的坚守，为“中国制造”在国际高端市场赢得了信任与尊重。

04 未来展望

随着中加能源合作不断深化，TZME 在加拿大市场的前景广阔。

从市场需求看，加拿大能源出口基础设施正进入快速发展阶段。除 REEF 项目外，不列颠哥伦比亚省还有多个液化天然气（LNG）出口设施处于规划与建设阶段，这些项目均需要大型模块化设备制造能力。

《中加联合声明》同时强调清洁能源合作与传统能源资源开发，也为 TZME 拓展风电、氢能等相关设备制造业务创造了有利机遇。

从企业成长看，TZME 通过加拿大项目的成功交付赢得了专业认可，与全球领先能源企业建立起稳固合作，为未来承接更多国际项目奠定了坚实基础。

REEF 项目首批模块已从天津港启航，驶向加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省。钢结构在阳光下闪耀，船尾浪花划出明亮弧线。与此同时，在 TZME 的车间里，新一批加拿大项目的钢板已完成切割，等待进入下一道工序。

从成品模块的跨太平洋航行，到新部件的精密制造，这样的场景正在中加能源合作新蓝图下，成为产业协作的新常态。
articles.titleEn: Bridging Continents, Building Energy Futures: TZME Powers a New Era of China-Canada Cooperation
articles.summaryEn: Following renewed China-Canada energy cooperation commitments, TZME is building critical infrastructure through landmark projects. As core contractor for Canada’s REEF Offshore Pipeline, the company manufactures massive 600-ton prefabricated modules to connect North America and Asian markets. Its integrated ship loaders also expand West Coast ports, showcasing full-system manufacturing strength. Through advanced modular techniques and strict international standards, TZME exemplifies high-end "China Manufacturing" in action. These projects physically embody deepening bilateral collaboration in the energy sector.
articles.contentEn:
Giant, 10,000-ton steel structures span the Pacific.

Here, the roar of machinery merges with the spark of welding—a symphony of industry as TZME forges a new energy corridor linking North America and Asia.

"We are committed to expanding bilateral trade, enhancing two-way investment, and deepening cooperation in the energy sector." During Canadian Prime Minister Mark J. Carney's visit to China in January 2026, China and Canada explicitly reaffirmed their shared commitment to strengthening energy cooperation in a joint statement.

This opens a new situation for the cooperation between the two countries' enterprises in the field of traditional energy and clean energy.

At TZME's Greenland manufacturing base, a shipment of large-scale pipeline gallery modules ready for deployment stands as a vivid embodiment of this collaborative vision.

01 New Policy Landscape

China-Canada relations are entering a new phase of development. During the Canadian Prime Minister's visit to China, the two countries clarified their cooperation priorities in areas such as energy and trade.

The China-Canada Joint Statement emphasized collaboration in clean energy and strengthened cooperation in developing traditional resources, including oil and natural gas.

This high-level consensus provides political guarantee and policy guidance for the deepening of practical cooperation between the two countries.

Benefiting from a favorable policy environment, Canada, as a major energy producer, is actively expanding its energy infrastructure. A key development is the Port of Prince Rupert in British Columbia, which is now strategically positioned as a vital hub for exporting North American energy to Asian markets, where market opportunities have become increasingly evident.

02 Project Achievements

TZME (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. has established a substantial presence in the Canadian market. Its two ongoing key projects align perfectly with the new direction of China-Canada energy cooperation.

The REEF Offshore Pipeline Project, a critical LPG export hub on Canada's west coast, is a joint venture co-developed by the Canadian energy company AltaGas and Royal Dutch Shell.

As the core contractor, TZME undertook the manufacturing of all 13 large-scale pipeline gallery modules.

This project employs modular prefabrication technology, with a single module measuring approximately 96 meters in length and weighing nearly 600 tons. The factory prefabrication rate reaches as high as 90%, significantly enhancing engineering efficiency and quality controllability. Scheduled for completion by the end of 2026, the project will serve as a critical energy corridor connecting North America with the Asian market.

Delivering two large ship loaders for the West Coast Terminal's Westshore project represents a further significant achievement for TZME in Canada. As part of this project, the company undertook the manufacture of all steel structures and the full integration of the electromechanical systems, delivering a critical port expansion component.

By rigorously adhering to multi-tiered client technical standards, TZME has demonstrated its capacity for coordinated execution and high-quality delivery in complex international projects. This success directly contributes to the infrastructure upgrade of Canada's West Coast ports, supporting the national strategy to expand energy export capacity.

03 Manufacturing Across Boundaries

TZME stands as an exemplar of "new quality productive forces" in the field of China-Canada energy cooperation. Through its advanced manufacturing practices, it demonstrates the innovative strength and global competitiveness of China's high-end equipment manufacturing industry.

TZME employs an advanced modular prefabrication and factory-integrated production model, transforming complex on-site construction into controlled factory operations. This methodology proved pivotal in the REEF project, yielding significant reductions in on-site construction time and marked improvements in engineering quality.

Meanwhile, By developing integrated electromechanical-hydraulic capabilities, TZME enables efficient factory integration and coordinated debugging of heavy equipment. This shift from standalone manufacturing to comprehensive system integration exemplifies the application of new-generation productivity in the equipment manufacturing sector.

The company adheres to full-process quality control and alignment with international standards, ensuring products comply with Canada's stringent industry regulations and safety standards. This commitment to quality has earned "China Manufacturing" credibility and respect in the international high-end market.

04 Future Prospects

With the deepening of China-Canada energy cooperation, TZME's prospects in the Canadian market are promising.

From a market demand perspective, Canada's energy export infrastructure is entering a phase of rapid development. In addition to the REEF project, British Columbia has several liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facilities currently under planning and construction. These projects all require manufacturing capabilities for large-scale modular equipment.

The China-Canada Joint Statement, which emphasizes both clean energy cooperation and traditional energy resource development, positions TZME favorably to pursue opportunities in manufacturing related equipment, such as wind turbines and hydrogen systems.

In terms of corporate growth, TZME has earned professional credibility through successful delivery of the Canadian project, establishing strong partnerships with leading global energy companies and laying a solid foundation for securing more international projects in the future.

The first shipment of modules for the REEF project has set sail from Tianjin Port, bound for British Columbia, Canada. Their steel frames gleam under the sun, and the waves at the stern trace a bright arc. Seamlessly, at TZME's workshops, steel plates for a new Canadian project have been cut, ready for the next stage.

From the trans-Pacific voyage of finished modules to the precise fabrication of new components, such scenes are becoming the new norm of industrial collaboration under the renewed blueprint of China-Canada energy cooperation.

articles.titleZh: TZME 2026 主题年会圆满举行
articles.summaryZh: 2 月 3 日，TZME 隆重举办“十八载风雨同舟，凝心聚力谱新篇”主题年会。
articles.contentZh:
2 月 3 日，TZME 隆重举办“十八载风雨同舟，凝心聚力谱新篇”主题年会。公司领导、全体员工，以及来自 30 多家客户与合作伙伴单位的代表近 900 人齐聚一堂，共同回顾奋斗历程，展望未来蓝图。

年会上，各部门呈现了丰富多彩、精彩纷呈的节目。活动还表彰了过去一年表现优异的供应商，颁发“战略合作伙伴奖”“年度最佳贡献奖”“卓越协作奖”等奖项，感谢其长期以来的支持与合作。

在战略讲话中，总经理兼董事长 Li Kun 回顾了公司十八年的发展历程。他指出，公司当前正面临全球产业链重构、大国地缘政治遏制，以及经济“三重压力”交织的复杂环境。但挑战之中也蕴含机遇，供应链安全、产业升级和发展新质生产力等重点方向，是突破当前局面的关键。

TZME 始终坚持“为员工创造福祉，提供更多‘有灵魂、能沟通’的产品服务世界”的使命，以“成为全球非标机械装备行业领导者”为愿景。通过精准的“四步定位法”，公司持续深耕定制非标机械赛道，产品超过 70 个品类，出口至 60 多个国家和地区。从迪士尼过山车到卡塔尔能源装船机，TZME 以“有灵魂的产品”参与或创造了 30 多项世界首次成果，稳步向愿景迈进。

Li Kun 强调，公司突破挑战的核心战略在于“共创复合价值”。通过客户幸福、员工福祉、社会贡献、资本持续增长和智慧系统五大价值协同，公司推动员工持股与利润共享、薪酬稳步增长，并以切实的纳税贡献履行社会责任，实现经济价值与社会价值的平衡。面向新征程，公司订单规模持续攀升，再创新高。未来，TZME 将以“六心”文化为基础，释放 13% 的主动潜能，通过闭环管理实现年度目标，推进数字化转型与海外拓展，在高质量发展道路上践行共同富裕，坚定向既定愿景前进。

整场年会在热烈、团结、向上的氛围中圆满结束。TZME 将以此为新起点，秉持“螺丝钉精神”，脚踏实地、锐意进取，以实际行动续写中国装备制造业的精彩篇章。
articles.titleEn: TZME's 2026 Themed Annual Conference Successfully Concluded
articles.summaryEn: On February 3, TZME held its grand annual gala under the theme "Eighteen Years of Journeying Together Through Storms, Uniting Our Wills to Forge a New Chapter."
articles.contentEn:
On February 3, TZME held its grand annual gala under the theme "Eighteen Years of Journeying Together Through Storms, Uniting Our Wills to Forge a New Chapter." Nearly 900 attendees, including company leaders, all employees, and representatives from over 30 client and partner organizations, gathered together to reflect on past endeavors and map out future blueprints.

At the annual gala, various departments presented a diverse and spectacular array of performances. The event also honored outstanding suppliers for their exceptional performance over the past year, presenting awards such as the "Strategic Partner Award," "Annual Best Contribution Award," and "Excellence in Collaboration Award" in recognition of their long-standing support and cooperation.

During the strategic address, the grand manager and Chairman of board, Li Kun reviewed the company's eighteen-year journey of development. He noted that the company is currently navigating a complex environment characterized by the restructuring of global industrial chains, geopolitical containment among major powers, and the triple pressures on the economy. However, within these challenges lie opportunities, with priorities such as supply chain security, industrial upgrading, and the development of new quality productive forces being key to breaking through the current impasse.

TZME has consistently adhered to its mission of "creating well-being for employees and providing more 'soulful, communicative' products to serve the world," with the vision of "becoming a global industry leader in the non-standard machinery equipment sector." Through its precise "Four-Step Positioning Method," the company has deepened its focus on the custom non-standard machinery track, offering over 70 product categories exported to more than 60 countries and regions. From Disney roller coasters to Qatar Energy ship loaders, TZME has participated in or created over 30 world-first achievements with its "soulful products," steadily advancing toward its vision.

Li Kun emphasized that the company's core strategy for breaking through challenges lies in "Co-creating Composite Value." By synergizing five key values—customer happiness, employee well-being, social contribution, sustained capital growth, and intelligent systems—the company ensures employee ownership and profit-sharing, stable salary growth, and fulfills social responsibility through tangible tax contributions, achieving a balance between economic and social value. Facing the new journey ahead, the company has seen its order scale continuously rise, reaching new heights. Moving forward, TZME will build upon its "Six-Hearted" culture, unleash 13% of its proactive potential, pursue annual goals through closed-loop management, advance digital transformation and overseas expansion, practice common prosperity on the path of high-quality development, and steadfastly progress toward its established vision.

The entire annual gala concluded successfully in an atmosphere of enthusiasm, unity, and upward momentum. TZME will take this event as a new starting point, upholding the "Spirit of the Screw," staying grounded, forging ahead with determination, and continuing to write a glorious chapter in China's equipment manufacturing industry through practical action.
